outcome: Appearance, Pulse, Grimace, Activity, and Respiration (APGAR) score at 1 and 5 minutes
cohort: 78 pregnant women, including 26 cases of placental chorangiosis and 52 controls, at King Saud University Medical City (KSUMC) between September 2018 and December 2021.
finding: Placental chorangiosis was significantly associated with an increased number of abortions, IUFD, and low neonatal APGAR scores at 5 minutes, but not with maternal age, BMI, type of gestation, gravidity, or parity.
